title: Core: AS2 Stage and Key class built-ins
description: Test compilation of Stage class: Stage.width, Stage.height, Stage.align, Stage.scaleMode, Stage.addListener(obj), Stage.removeListener(obj). Test Key class: Key.isDown(code), Key.UP, Key.DOWN, Key.LEFT, Key.RIGHT, Key.ENTER, Key.SPACE, Key.SHIFT. Test Mouse class: Mouse.hide(), Mouse.show(). All should compile without error and emit ActionGetVariable (0x1c) + ActionGetMember (0x4f) for property access.
